text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I apologize, I've gained weight!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what should I eat today—hm? 
Seasonal Color Bowl... not a name I hear 
often.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Worker
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that one? It's a limited-time rice 
bowl using seasonal ingredients! It's 
delicious, nutritious, and highly 
recommended!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Then I definitely have to eat it!
The 
"Voice of Destiny" is telling me to do
so, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: That seasonal bowl was truly delicious!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And then I realized. How important it is 
to eat when you need to!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And so, in search of seasonal delicacies, 
we toured famous restaurants—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
At times, I even traveled straight to the 
source to savor all kinds of ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"And as you can see, that resulted in 
quite a massive gain! In short, I ate too 
much!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, don't you think? By my own 
will, I continued to feast on in-season 
ingredients to my heart's content.
choice_data_list: For someone saying that, you don't...
For someone saying that, you don't...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I ended up gaining weight,
but that's all 
there is to it."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, thanks to eating so much, 
energy is surging through my body! I knew 
I was right all along!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, much appreciated,
Trainer! With this 
seasonal boost, feels like I can do 
anything right now!
choice_data_list: I'll think up a weight-loss plan t...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though the routine was set a bit on the 
harder side, Epiphaneia handled it with 
ease and successfully slimmed down.
